slide3_parity_density.input_matrix: 24 parity NPZ outputs: 4 families x 3 seeds x 2 splits; family/seed/split parsed from exact eval_id filenames
slide3_parity_density.correlation_basis: all finite held-out test parity observations pooled across seeds per family
slide3_parity_density.hexbin_basis: all finite train plus held-out test parity observations pooled across seeds per family
slide3_parity_density.point_overlay: deterministic evenly spaced vector sample, max 2200 train and max 2200 held-out test points per panel
slide3_parity_density.energy_inset: per-family local inset centered on the densest held-out test energy core; both axes use hexbin count density and deterministic vector train/test overlays

energy_normalization.reference: E0 is the median held-out DFT energy within the selected local core for each family
energy_normalization.applied_to: DFT and MLIP axes identically inside the inset
energy_normalization.absolute_context: the main energy panels retain absolute DFT/MLIP energy values
energy_normalization.effect_on_error: translation only; parity residuals, RMSE, Spearman, and Pearson are unchanged

force_focus.method: shared square limits of -5.25 to +5.25 eV/A for the full force row, retaining the central distribution with light visual whitespace
